assets.brief: A travel-port island with a big friendly ocean liner docked at the back centre, three round funnels and portholes. Left: a hot-air balloon launch field with one colourful balloon. Right: a waiting hall with a large globe on its domed roof. Front centre: a pier with stacked suitcases and a signpost of blank arrows pointing far away. No flags of real countries. Ocean blue, white ship, warm sand, many-coloured luggage; adventurous and welcoming.

assets.brief: A musical meadow island with an open white bandstand pavilion at the back centre. Left: a xylophone path of coloured stepping planks. Right: a drum circle of tree stumps. Front centre: a row of bells strung between two posts beside a flower bed in a wave shape. Music notes may appear only as a few simple floating shapes, never as notation or text. Meadow green, white, raspberry, sky blue, gold.

assets.brief: A painterly valley island with a waterfall at the back centre that flows in soft rainbow bands into a pool. The hills are dabbed with pastel paint strokes. Left: an easel on a hilltop with a blank canvas and paint pots. Right: a hut with a palette-shaped roof. Front centre: a round pool where colours swirl and mix, ringed by paintbrush-shaped flowers. Joyful pastel rainbow tones on a creamy base; never neon.

Right: a cardboard castle under construction with glue pots. Front centre: a basket of origami birds and buttons. Warm wood, wool colours, kraft-paper browns, coral and teal accents.

assets.brief: A sporty island with a small oval running track around a football pitch with two goals at the back centre. Left: a round swimming pool with a small slide. Right: a climbing frame and a balancing beam. Front centre: a board with simple sport pictograms (no text) and a basket of balls. Turf green, track terracotta, pool blue, white lines; energetic but uncluttered.

assets.brief: A calm, welcoming village island around a big linden tree with a round bench at the back centre. Left: two little houses connected by a rope bridge. Right: a quiet garden corner with a bench for two and cushions. Front left: a pond with stepping stones that lead from two sides to a meeting stone in the middle. Front right: a friendly signpost with blank arrows. Soft, neutral, warm colours (sage, cream, soft peach); peaceful and inclusive, no symbols, no faces showing strong emotions.

Left: a long shared table with plates and a cake. Right: a path lined with lanterns. Front centre: a ring of chairs around a flat storytelling stone. Neutral and inclusive: no religious symbols, flags or specific holidays. Warm amber light, cream, soft plum and gold.

assets.brief: A calm mountain island with a winding staircase path up to a peak at the back centre, where a small hut has a big round window. Left: a quiet pavilion beside a still pond. Right: a hill with a planning board of plain coloured cards. Front centre: a bench with a stack of neat plain boxes like a tidy desk. Cool blue snow, pine green, warm wood, soft yellow light.

assets.brief: A whimsical surprise island, the most playful of the world. At the back centre a big hill shaped like a wrapped gift box with a bow on top. Left: a hot-air balloon tethered to a post. Right: a spiral seashell house. Front centre: a little round door in a mossy rock with sparkles around it. Lilac, peach, mint and gold; joyful and curious.
